decision_reason: High diffusion adds a scattering veil while edges stay closer to the source than in optical-softness highs. Architecture and portrait isolate it best. Landscape invents a sun. Distinct enough to stay in the basis as provisional.
entanglement_notes: Often co-produces atmospheric haze and god rays.
Landscape high adds flare orbs and a time-of-day shift.
next_experiments: Diffusion vs veiling glare vs atmospheric haze on the gallery and portrait only.
protocol: Hold subject via locked anchor images. image_edit each anchor to low, medium, and high of one candidate. Do not change other dimensions on purpose.
title: Controlled variation of diffusion
